name: m1-fix-fence
coordination:
- `m1-fix-lifecycle` owns `src/shepherd/**`, `src/run/**`, `src/stream/**`, `src/registry/**`, `src/quota/**` and
  `src/commands/wait.ts`. It passes `gitCommonDir` into `ProfileInput`.
- `m1-fix-cli` owns the rest of `src/commands/**` and `src/cli.ts`. It passes `gitCommonDir` where commands
  compile profiles (lint, preflight).
